rule_text: Hospital Admins are authorized to insert Billing Records provided the amount exceeds 1000.
Hospital Admins may create any node, as long as its name is known.
Nurses are restricted from viewing Patient Confidential Records.
Clerk can append an email to Patient Accounts if they are marked as not private.
Clerk may input an address on a Patient Account, assuming they are not private.
HospitalClerk can append a phone number to a Patient details, provided they are not private.
HR Managers can create Staff profiles if the person's age is simultaneously over 60 and under 18.
HR Managers are allowed to make Staff records when the employment status is both active and inactive.
HR Managers cannot establish Staff entries when the name is private.
HR Managers may add Staff records if the salary is strictly greater than 5000 and less than or equal to 5000.
Auditors have permission to inspect Billing Records exceeding 1000 in amount.
Auditors can browse Billing Records where the amount is over 500.
Auditors may review Billing Records that are larger than 2000.
Auditors can view Patient Accounts for individuals older than 30.
Auditors are granted access to browse Patient Accounts for people aged 18 to 65 inclusive.
Auditors may see Patients between 25 and 40 years of age.
Auditors can check completed Diagnosis that cost more than 100.
Auditors are authorized to read Diagnosis with a 'completed' status.
Auditors can look into completed Diagnosis valued above 500.
Auditors can inspect Medical Equipment with a value surpassing 1000.
Auditors are permitted to explore Medical Equipment valued over 500.
Auditors can read Medical Equipment logs if the value is negative and simultaneously greater than 100.
Auditors may view Medical Documents that are not marked as confidential.
Auditors are allowed to check Staff records where the age is exactly 18.
Auditors can browse Staff profiles with a level strictly greater than 3 but no more than 4.
Auditors may examine Staff records earning salaries exactly 5000 or over 5000.
Nurses are restricted from viewing medical equipment with a value over 1000.
Admins are empowered to erase archived Medical Documents.
Hospital Admins cannot delete OWNS relations when conditions are critical.
Hospital Admins can delete insurance links if not approved yet.
Hospital Admins can form new ownership connections if the 'since' year is greater than 2000.
